note: Also the auxiliary for movement verbs and all pronominal verbs: je suis allé, je me suis levé.
ex: Je suis prêt. — I'm ready.

note: Auxiliary for most past tenses; used for age and states: avoir faim, avoir froid, avoir 20 ans.
ex: J'ai vingt ans. — I'm twenty.

note: One verb for both do and make; also weather (il fait froid) and 'have sth done' (faire réparer).
ex: Il fait beau. — The weather is nice.

note: aller + infinitive = near future: je vais partir = I'm going to leave.
pron: s'en aller = to go away, leave
ex: Comment ça va ? — How are you?

note: Covers both 'say' and 'tell'; vouloir dire = to mean.
ex: Dis-moi la vérité. — Tell me the truth.

en: can; to be able to; may
note: Covers ability and permission: Je peux entrer ? = May I come in?
pron: se pouvoir = to be possible (il se peut que…)
ex: Tu peux m'aider ? — Can you help me?

note: vouloir dire = to mean; en vouloir à qqn = to hold a grudge against sb.
ex: Je voudrais un café. — I'd like a coffee.
On se voit demain. — See you tomorrow.

en: to know (facts); to know how to
note: savoir = know a fact / how to do sth; connaître = be acquainted with a person or place.
ex: Je sais nager. — I can swim.

en: must; to have to; to owe
note: Also 'to owe': je te dois 10 €. Conditional je devrais = I should.
ex: Je dois partir. — I have to leave.

note: venir de + infinitive = to have just done: je viens de manger.
ex: Je viens de manger. — I've just eaten.
Je prends un café. — I'll have a coffee.
Tu parles français ? — Do you speak French?

note: je suis = I am (être) AND I follow (suivre); context decides.
ex: Suivez-moi. — Follow me.

en: to be necessary (il faut = one must)
note: Impersonal only: il faut partir = we/I must go; il me faut = I need.
ex: Il faut partir. — We have to go.

en: to pass; to spend (time); to drop by
faux: passer un examen = to take (not pass) an exam
ex: Je passe te voir. — I'll drop by to see you.
Je crois que oui. — I think so.

note: aimer = love (people) / like (things); aimer bien a person = to like (weaker than aimer).
ex: Je t'aime. — I love you.

note: penser à = to think about; penser de = to have an opinion of.
ex: Je pense à toi. — I'm thinking of you.
Je le trouve sympa. — I think he's nice.

note: Takes a direct object, no 'at': regarder la télé = to watch TV.
ex: Regarde ça ! — Look at that!

note: Leave sth/sb behind (laisser les clés) and also 'let' (laisse-moi partir).
ex: Laisse-moi tranquille. — Leave me alone.
Donne-moi ton numéro. — Give me your number.

en: to put; to put on (clothes); to take (time)
ex: Mets ton manteau. — Put on your coat.

faux: ≠ attend — means to wait for (attend = assister à)
note: No preposition: attendre le bus = to wait for the bus.
ex: Je t'attends. — I'm waiting for you.

en: to arrive; to happen; to manage (to)
note: arriver à + infinitive = to manage to: je n'arrive pas à dormir.
ex: Qu'est-ce qui est arrivé ? — What happened?
Je lui demande l'heure. — I ask him the time.

faux: ≠ rest — means to stay (rest = se reposer)
ex: Reste ici. — Stay here.

pron: s'appeler = to be called (je m'appelle… = my name is…)
ex: Je t'appelle ce soir. — I'll call you tonight.

note: Intransitive: partir de Paris; quitter takes a direct object: quitter Paris.
ex: Le train part à huit heures. — The train leaves at eight.

note: Know people, places, works; savoir = know facts / how to.
ex: Tu connais Paul ? — Do you know Paul?

en: to go out; to take out
note: sortir avec qqn = to go out with / date sb.
ex: On sort ce soir ? — Shall we go out tonight?
Je ne comprends pas. — I don't understand.

faux: Mainly means to stop; 'arrest' only for police
pron: s'arrêter = to stop (oneself), come to a halt
ex: Arrête ! — Stop it!
Tu m'entends ? — Can you hear me?
Il est mort en 2010. — He died in 2010.

note: Both 'feel' and 'smell' (sense): ça sent bon = it smells good.
pron: se sentir = to feel (well, ill, tired)
ex: Ça sent bon. — It smells good.

note: tenir à = to care about / insist on; tiens ! = here! / well!
ex: Tiens ma main. — Hold my hand.

note: No preposition: chercher ses clés. aller chercher = to go and get / pick up.
ex: Je cherche mes clés. — I'm looking for my keys.
Je reviens tout de suite. — I'll be right back.

en: to give back; to make (+ adjective)
note: rendre + adj = to make: ça me rend triste = it makes me sad.
pron: se rendre = to go to / surrender
ex: Rends-moi mon livre. — Give me back my book.
Il est devenu médecin. — He became a doctor.

note: vivre = be alive / live one's life; habiter = to live (reside) somewhere.
ex: Il vit seul. — He lives alone.
Essaie encore. — Try again.

note: jouer à + game/sport, jouer de + instrument.
ex: Il joue du piano. — He plays the piano.

note: tomber amoureux = to fall in love; tomber sur = to run into.
ex: Il est tombé. — He fell.

note: entrer dans + place: entrer dans la maison.

faux: ≠ re-enter — usually means to go back home
ex: Je rentre à la maison. — I'm going home.
Il semble fatigué. — He seems tired.

pron: s'en tirer = to manage, get by
ex: Tirez la porte. — Pull the door.

note: Also 'to wear': elle porte une robe.
ex: Elle porte une robe rouge. — She's wearing a red dress.

note: No preposition: écouter la radio = to listen to the radio.
Reversed structure: ça me plaît = I like it (lit. it pleases me).
ex: Ça te plaît ? — Do you like it?

note: répondre à qqn / à une question.

ex: Asseyez-vous. — Sit down.

en: to find (again); to meet up with
pron: se retrouver = to meet up; to end up
ex: On se retrouve à huit heures. — Let's meet at eight.

faux: ≠ march (mostly) — means to walk; to work (machine)
ex: Ça ne marche pas. — It doesn't work.
Je travaille demain. — I'm working tomorrow.

en: to go up; to climb; to get in (vehicle)
ex: Monte dans la voiture. — Get in the car.

note: apprendre qqch à qqn = to teach sb sth; also 'to hear, find out (news)'.
ex: J'apprends le français. — I'm learning French.

note: poser une question = to ask a question.
ex: Pose ton sac ici. — Put your bag down here.

pron: se lever = to get up; (sun) to rise
ex: Levez la main. — Raise your hand.
Montre-moi ta photo. — Show me your photo.

note: servir à = to be used for: ça sert à quoi ? = what's it for?
pron: se servir de = to use; se servir = to help oneself

ex: Gardez la monnaie. — Keep the change.

note: Always takes an object: quitter la maison. Ne quittez pas = hold the line (phone).
ex: Il a quitté sa femme. — He left his wife.

pron: s'occuper de = to take care of, deal with

ex: Tournez à gauche. — Turn left.

en: (vulgar) to do; to put; to give
note: Vulgar slang: qu'est-ce que tu fous ? = what the hell are you doing?
pron: se foutre de = not to give a damn about; to mock
ex: Je m'en fous. — I don't give a damn.

en: to seem; to appear; to be published
ex: Il paraît que… — Apparently…

note: No preposition: payer le repas = to pay for the meal.

ex: Envoie-moi un message. — Send me a message.

en: to go down; to get off; to take down
ex: Je descends ici. — I'm getting off here.

en: to go back; to turn over

note: Almost always pronominal; the noun un souvenir = memory (also keepsake).
ex: Je me souviens de toi. — I remember you.
Jette ça à la poubelle. — Throw that in the bin.
Raconte-moi une histoire. — Tell me a story.
Ça me rappelle ma mère. — That reminds me of my mother.
Il gagne bien sa vie. — He earns a good living.

en: to take back; to resume; to have more
ex: Reprends du gâteau. — Have some more cake.
Excusez-moi. — Excuse me.
Tu me fais rire. — You make me laugh.

en: to touch; to receive (money); to hit (target)
note: toucher un salaire = to receive a salary.
Reversed structure: tu me manques = I miss you (lit. you are lacking to me).
ex: Tu me manques. — I miss you.
J'espère que oui. — I hope so.

faux: Mainly 'to matter' (peu importe); also to import
note: n'importe qui/quoi/où = anyone/anything/anywhere.
ex: Peu importe. — It doesn't matter.

note: compter + infinitive = to intend to; compter sur = to count on.
Meet by chance or for the first time; retrouver = meet up (planned).
ex: Je l'ai rencontré à Paris. — I met him in Paris.

note: je vous en prie = you're welcome / please, go ahead.
ex: Je vous en prie. — You're welcome.

pron: il s'agit de = it's about / it's a matter of
ex: De quoi s'agit-il ? — What is it about?
Poussez la porte. — Push the door.

note: il vaut mieux = it's better to; ça vaut la peine = it's worth it.
ex: Ça vaut combien ? — How much is it worth?

en: to offer; to give (as a gift)
faux: Often 'to give as a present' / 'to treat sb to'
ex: Je t'offre un verre. — Let me buy you a drink.
Ça suffit ! — That's enough!
Où as-tu caché les clés ? — Where did you hide the keys?

en: to put to bed; to lay down
note: coucher avec qqn = to sleep with sb (sexual).
pron: se coucher = to go to bed; (sun) to set
ex: Je me couche tôt. — I go to bed early.

note: emmener = take a person along; emporter = take a thing away.
ex: Je t'emmène à l'école. — I'll take you to school.

note: apporter = bring a thing; amener = bring a person.
ex: Apporte du pain. — Bring some bread.
Ne bouge pas ! — Don't move!

pron: se permettre = to afford; to take the liberty

ex: Ne crie pas ! — Don't shout!

en: to put back; to hand over; to postpone

ex: On frappe à la porte. — Someone's knocking.

note: Two unrelated meanings: to fly AND to steal.
ex: Il m'a volé mon sac. — He stole my bag.
Tu sais conduire ? — Can you drive?

pron: s'approcher de = to come close to

en: to upset; (être désolé) to be sorry
note: Used almost only as désolé(e) = sorry.
ex: Je suis désolé. — I'm sorry.

note: ressembler à qqn; se ressembler = to look alike.
ex: Tu ressembles à ta mère. — You look like your mother.

note: au revoir = goodbye (lit. until seeing again).
ex: Au revoir ! — Goodbye!
Réveille-moi à sept heures. — Wake me at seven.
Je te présente Marie. — This is Marie.

pron: se taire = to be / keep quiet
ex: Tais-toi ! — Be quiet!
La pluie m'empêche de sortir. — The rain stops me going out.
